answer: The meadow I would price into every new account is Acknowledged sheep shearer licence with shearers association attestation: a licence the association renews after shearing audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a licence the association renews after shearing audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the opal is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The ivory is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
